name: Third Mental Retardation House
description: Apartments where HUD helps pay the rent, so what you pay is based on your income (3 such units).
eligibility: For people with disabilities, based on income.

steps: Call 937-866-8127 to ask if the wait list is open.
Ask how to apply, and what to bring.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: Each building has its own wait list. Putting your name on several can help.
